projects.name: Clinic Management System
projects.description:
We partnered with a growing multi-doctor clinic to replace three disconnected spreadsheets and a paper appointment book with a single, reliable system their front-desk and clinical staff could actually enjoy using. The result is a full clinic operations platform that handles everything from the first phone call to the final invoice.

Key Highlights

  • Real-time appointment scheduling with conflict detection across multiple doctors and rooms
  • Centralized patient records — history, prescriptions, lab results and visit notes in one timeline
  • Automated billing with itemized invoices, insurance claim tracking and payment reminders
  • Role-based access so receptionists, nurses and doctors each see only what they need
  • Built-in reporting for daily footfall, revenue and doctor-wise performance

Since launch, the clinic has cut patient check-in time by more than half and eliminated double-bookings entirely, freeing the front-desk team to focus on patients instead of paperwork.

projects.name: School Management ERP
projects.description:
Built for a mid-sized private school network, this ERP unifies admissions, day-to-day academics and finance across multiple campuses that previously ran on separate, inconsistent tools. Administrators, teachers and parents now share one source of truth.

Key Highlights

  • End-to-end admissions workflow — application, document verification, seat allocation and fee assignment
  • Digital attendance with SMS/email alerts sent automatically to parents
  • Exam and result management with auto-generated report cards and grade analytics
  • Fee collection with installment plans, late-fee rules and an online parent payment portal
  • A dedicated dashboard per role: administration, teaching staff and parents

The school now runs three campuses from a single admin console, and parent-teacher communication that used to happen through phone calls now happens instantly inside the platform.

projects.name: Restaurant POS
projects.description:
A regional restaurant chain needed a point-of-sale system fast enough for a dinner rush and reliable enough to survive a flaky internet connection. We built a desktop-first POS with an offline-capable core and a live kitchen display that keeps the kitchen and floor staff perfectly in sync.

Key Highlights

  • Table-side ordering synced instantly to a kitchen display system (KDS) — no more shouted tickets
  • Split bills, custom modifiers and tip handling built for real restaurant floor workflows
  • Offline-first design that queues orders locally and syncs the moment connectivity returns
  • Live sales analytics: best-sellers, peak hours and per-table turnover
  • Multi-terminal support so several checkout stations share one live order queue

Average order-to-kitchen time dropped from over a minute of manual relay to a few seconds, and the chain now has real visibility into which dishes actually perform.

projects.name: Inventory Management System
projects.description:
A distribution business with three warehouses came to us drowning in stock-count spreadsheets and last-minute reorder panics. We delivered a real-time inventory platform that tracks every unit from purchase order to shelf, across every location, with nobody needing to touch Excel again.

Key Highlights

  • Live stock levels across multiple warehouses with per-location transfer tracking
  • Automated low-stock alerts and one-click purchase order generation
  • Barcode-based receiving and picking to cut manual entry errors
  • Supplier and purchasing history with cost trend reporting
  • Role-based dashboards for warehouse staff, purchasing and management

Stockouts on fast-moving items dropped sharply within the first quarter, and month-end stock reconciliation — once a two-day exercise — now takes minutes.

projects.name: Hospital Management Software
projects.description:
This was our most ambitious healthcare build: a single platform coordinating outpatient (OPD), inpatient (IPD), pharmacy, diagnostic labs and billing for a full-service hospital. Every department needed its own workflow, yet all of them had to share one accurate patient record.

Key Highlights

  • Unified patient record shared across OPD, IPD, pharmacy and lab departments
  • Bed management and ward allocation with live occupancy tracking
  • Pharmacy module with stock-linked prescription dispensing
  • Lab order-to-result workflow with digital report delivery
  • Consolidated billing that automatically pulls charges from every department a patient visits

What used to require patients to carry paper files between departments now happens automatically in the background — doctors, pharmacists and lab technicians all work from the same live record.

projects.name: Customer Support Live Chat
projects.description:
A SaaS company was losing customers to slow email-only support. We built a real-time live chat and ticketing platform that lets their support team respond in seconds instead of hours, without losing the structure of a proper ticketing workflow.

Key Highlights

  • Embeddable live chat widget with instant, WebSocket-powered messaging
  • Automatic ticket creation from chat conversations, emails and web forms in one inbox
  • Canned responses and internal notes so agents can move faster without sounding robotic
  • Real-time agent availability and smart conversation routing
  • Response-time and satisfaction reporting for support managers

Average first-response time fell from hours to under a minute, and the support team now handles a higher ticket volume with the same headcount.

projects.name: Car Rental Management System
projects.description:
A car rental operator running a growing fleet needed to move off manual booking sheets and phone-based contracts. We built a single dashboard covering the entire rental lifecycle — from fleet availability to signed contract to online payment.

Key Highlights

  • Live fleet availability calendar that prevents double-booking any vehicle
  • Digital rental agreements generated and signed directly in the booking flow
  • Integrated online payments with deposit handling and automatic refunds
  • Maintenance scheduling tied to mileage and rental history per vehicle
  • Branch-wise reporting on utilization, revenue and fleet health

The operator now runs bookings across multiple branches from one dashboard, with fleet utilization visibility they never had with the old paper-and-spreadsheet process.

projects.name: Real Estate CRM
projects.description:
A real estate agency needed to stop losing leads between spreadsheets, WhatsApp chats and sticky notes. We built a purpose-made CRM that captures every enquiry automatically and walks agents through a proper sales pipeline, from first contact to closed deal.

Key Highlights

  • Automatic lead capture from the website, phone enquiries and listing portals
  • Visual sales pipeline with drag-and-drop stage tracking per lead
  • Property listing management with photos, pricing and availability status
  • Automated follow-up reminders so no lead goes cold unnoticed
  • Agent-wise performance dashboards for conversion rate and deal value

Lead response time improved dramatically, and management finally has a clear, real-time view of the pipeline instead of chasing agents for weekly updates.

projects.name: Accounting Software
projects.description:
A small accounting firm serving dozens of SME clients needed to move beyond generic spreadsheets without the cost and complexity of enterprise accounting suites. We built lean, desktop-based accounting software focused on exactly what they use every day.

Key Highlights

  • Invoicing and expense tracking with recurring billing support
  • Automated ledger posting — journal entries update every linked report instantly
  • Tax computation aligned to local filing requirements, reducing manual calculation
  • Financial reports (P&L, balance sheet, cash flow) generated in a couple of clicks
  • Multi-client support so the firm can manage every customer from one installation

Month-end closing that used to take the firm most of a week now wraps up in a couple of days, with far fewer reconciliation errors to chase down.

projects.name: HR & Payroll System
projects.description:
A 200-person company was still running payroll through a maze of spreadsheets that took days to reconcile and were painfully easy to get wrong. We replaced it with an HR and payroll system that automates the entire cycle from clock-in to payslip.

Key Highlights

  • Centralized employee records — contracts, documents and role history in one profile
  • Attendance and leave management with manager approval workflows
  • Automated payroll runs that factor in attendance, overtime, leaves and deductions
  • Payslip generation and distribution with a self-service employee portal
  • Compliance-ready reports for tax and statutory filings

What used to be a multi-day, error-prone payroll cycle now runs in a few hours each month, and employees get instant, transparent access to their own records.

projects.name: Food Delivery App
projects.description:
We built a two-sided food delivery platform — a customer ordering app and a rider app — for a local delivery startup competing against national chains. The focus was speed: fast ordering, fast dispatch and live tracking that keeps customers confident their food is on the way.

Key Highlights

  • Customer app with restaurant browsing, live cart and one-tap reordering
  • Rider app with optimized delivery routing and real-time order updates
  • Live GPS order tracking so customers watch their delivery in real time
  • Integrated in-app payments alongside cash-on-delivery support
  • Automated rider assignment based on proximity and current load

The platform now handles peak-hour order surges smoothly, with average delivery time consistently beating the startup’s original target.

projects.name: Property Finder App
projects.description:
A property portal wanted to move beyond static listings and give house-hunters a genuinely mobile-first experience — one where browsing, booking a viewing and messaging an agent all happen without ever leaving the app.

Key Highlights

  • Location-aware property search with rich filters (price, type, amenities, distance)
  • In-app scheduling for property tours directly with listing agents
  • Built-in messaging so buyers and agents never need to leave the platform
  • Saved searches with push notifications when a matching property is listed
  • High-resolution photo galleries and map-based browsing

Agents on the platform report faster response cycles with prospective buyers, and users spend noticeably longer sessions browsing thanks to the smoother in-app experience.

hero.title: Let's Start a Conversation
hero.subtitle: Whether you have a project in mind or just a question — our team usually replies within one business day.

faqs.question: How fast do you reply?
faqs.answer: We aim to respond to every enquiry within one business day — most of the time it's a lot sooner. If your project is urgent, mention it in your message and we'll prioritize it.

faqs.question: Do you sign NDAs?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. We're happy to sign a mutual NDA before discussing any sensitive details of your project — just let us know when you reach out.

faqs.question: What's your typical project process?
faqs.answer: We start with a discovery call, follow up with a scoped proposal and timeline, then move through design, development, testing and launch in clear, milestone-based sprints.

faqs.question: Do you work with startups or only enterprises?
faqs.answer: Both. Our team is built to flex — from lean MVPs for early-stage startups to complex, multi-department systems for established enterprises.

faqs.question: What information should I include in my message?
faqs.answer: A short description of what you're building, your rough timeline, and any budget range you have in mind. The more context you give us, the faster we can respond with something useful.
